name: Dijkstra's Algorithm
purpose: Finds shortest-distance route with non-negative edge weights
description: Explores vertices radially from the source node, expanding the least cumulative distance path using a binary min-heap PriorityQueue.
sampleRoute: Financial District â Gachibowli â Hitech City â Ameerpet â Begumpet â Secunderabad

name: A* Search Algorithm
purpose: Finds fastest travel time route using admissible Haversine heuristic
description: Uses f(n) = g(n) + h(n) where g(n) is actual accumulated travel duration and h(n) is the Haversine distance heuristic divided by max speed.
sampleRoute: Financial District â Outer Ring Road (ORR) â Kukatpally â Begumpet â Secunderabad
keyOptimization: Prunes unpromising search directions to find fastest path in fewest iterations.

name: Modified Dijkstra (Multi-Criteria)
purpose: Optimizes multi-objective utility combining distance, time, safety, tolls, fuel, weather & scenery
description: Normalizes heterogeneous physical units (km, minutes, INR, safety ratings) into a balanced multi-criteria cost function weighted by user preference sliders.
sampleRoute: Financial District â Gachibowli â Madhapur â Jubilee Hills â Panjagutta â Begumpet â Secunderabad
keyOptimization: Balances user trade-offs (e.g. 0 toll with 9.2 safety score).

name: Breadth-First Search (BFS)
purpose: Discovers EV charging station hubs across unweighted graph topological layers
description: Explores reachable graph vertices layer by layer to discover high-speed EV charging stations and battery-swap stations along candidate corridors.
sampleRoute: Discovered 8 Fast Charging Plazas along Western and Central IT corridors
keyOptimization: Guarantees discovery of nearest EV facilities in minimum topological hops.

name: Depth-First Search (DFS)
purpose: Explores scenic alternative routes and enumerates route candidates with backtracking
description: Deeply traverses natural corridors, lake views, and green ridges (KBR Park, Durgam Cheruvu bridge, Hussain Sagar) to assemble scenic alternative routes.
sampleRoute: Gachibowli â Botanical Garden (Kondapur) â Madhapur Cable Bridge â Jubilee Hills Ridge â KBR Park â Hussain Sagar Lake View
keyOptimization: Exhaustively evaluates aesthetic score combinations along candidate subpaths.
